Captured flag PNG provenance

Source distribution: Polylang Free 3.8.10, installed from WordPress.org.
Source files: polylang/flags/gb.png and polylang/flags/fr.png.
These are unchanged HTTP response bytes, retained only as producer test evidence.
Polylang is distributed under GPLv2 or later; its readme credits famfamfam as the
source of most included flags and identifies those flags as public domain.
Upstream: https://wordpress.org/plugins/polylang/
Flag-source credit: http://famfamfam.com/
